PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.PackHint: Reusable level-scaled Chase obstacle cards for city, wilderness, dungeon, coast, mountain, and social routes.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.city-crowded-: Merchants, shoppers, and handcarts turn the street into a moving wall.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.city-overturn: A toppled cart and scattered cargo block the fastest line through the street.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.city-rooftop-: The route leaps from one roof to the next across a dangerous open gap.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.city-narrow-a: A cramped side alley twists between walls, crates, and startled residents.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.city-city-gat: The city gate is already closing as the chase reaches the walls.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.city-canal-cr: A narrow canal cuts across the route, with only awkward ways to the far side.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.city-festival: A loud procession fills the avenue with dancers, banners, and spectators.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.city-construc: Scaffolding offers a fast elevated route, but every plank and ladder shifts underfoot.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.city-watch-pa: A patrol steps into the route at exactly the wrong moment and demands an explanation.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.city-laundry-: Lines of laundry crisscross a tight courtyard and snag anyone moving too quickly.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.city-crowded-: A broad public stairway is packed with people moving in both directions.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.city-carriage: Fast carriages and wagons stream through an intersection with barely a gap between them.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.wilderness-fa: A massive fallen tree blocks the trail from bank to bank.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.wilderness-th: Dense thorny growth closes around the trail and tears at anyone forcing through.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.wilderness-sw: Recent rain has turned a normally shallow stream into a fast, muddy barrier.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.wilderness-mu: A steep slope has become slick mud, making every step a contest for balance.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.wilderness-an: A frightened herd surges across the chase route in a wall of hooves and bodies.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.wilderness-lo: Loose stones slide underfoot and send noisy cascades down the slope.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.wilderness-de: The trail disappears into tangled brush where speed depends on reading the terrain.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.wilderness-hi: A narrow ravine lies concealed by brush until the ground suddenly drops away.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.wilderness-qu: Soft ground gives way beneath the runners and begins to pull at boots and legs.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.wilderness-bu: Fire races through dry brush and cuts across the route in waves of heat and smoke.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.wilderness-ga: A barely visible game trail offers a shorter route through rough terrain.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.wilderness-lo: A single fallen trunk spans a stream or gully with little room for error.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.dungeon-portc: A heavy portcullis crashes downward and threatens to divide the chase.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.dungeon-colla: Stonework cracks and falls as the corridor begins to collapse around the runners.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.dungeon-trapp: A suspicious stretch of floor hides plates, pits, or other dungeon mechanisms.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.dungeon-flood: Dark water fills the passage and hides the safest footing.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.dungeon-rotat: A huge stone mechanism turns across the passage and repeatedly blocks the route.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.dungeon-locke: A reinforced iron door stands between the chase and the next corridor.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.dungeon-crumb: Ancient stairs shed stone beneath every hurried footstep.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.dungeon-swing: Old trap blades sweep back and forth across the only open path.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.dungeon-dark-: Intersecting passages vanish into darkness and make the direct route hard to judge.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.dungeon-chain: A hanging chain or broken support is the only fast way across a deep opening.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.dungeon-arcan: A magical seal flares to life across the corridor as the chase approaches.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.dungeon-maint: A narrow service shaft bypasses part of the dungeon for anyone who can use it quickly.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.coast-crashin: Heavy surf pounds the shoreline and repeatedly cuts across the fastest route.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.coast-slipper: Spray-slick timbers turn a narrow jetty into a balance test at full speed.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.coast-fishing: Coiled ropes and drying nets cover the dock in ankle-catching loops.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.coast-tide-po: Broken rock and deep tide pools force an irregular path along the shore.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.coast-rocking: Small boats tied side by side offer a quick but unstable path across the harbor.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.coast-cargo-c: A dockside crane can turn height and swinging cargo into an unexpected shortcut.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.coast-sea-cav: A sea cave cuts through the headland, but waves and darkness make it treacherous.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.coast-rising-: The tide is rapidly swallowing the strip of shore used by the chase.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.coast-dockwor: Workers hauling cargo fill the wharf and react badly to people charging through.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.coast-gull-sw: A cloud of screaming gulls erupts around spilled food and obscures the route.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.coast-broken-: Missing planks leave a jagged sequence of gaps over cold harbor water.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.coast-harbor-: A heavy chain drawn across the waterfront blocks passage at chest height.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.mountain-narr: The path narrows to a ledge with a long drop immediately beside it.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.mountain-rock: Loose rock tears down the mountainside and crosses the route in bouncing waves.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.mountain-snow: Deep snow hides uneven ground and steals momentum from every stride.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.mountain-icy-: A sheet of hard ice covers the slope and offers almost no secure footing.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.mountain-rope: A weathered rope bridge sways over open air and groans under sudden weight.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.mountain-moun: A herd of mountain goats blocks the narrow trail and refuses to move predictably.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.mountain-aval: The chase enters unstable snow where a wrong move can bring the whole slope down.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.mountain-thin: The steep ascent and thin air make maintaining speed increasingly difficult.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.mountain-swit: A steep direct climb can cut across several bends of the safer mountain path.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.mountain-glac: A blue-black crevasse splits the glacier across the direction of travel.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.mountain-clif: The route rises abruptly up a rock face with only narrow holds.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.mountain-mine: An old mountain mine track offers a fast line through tunnels and across trestles.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.social-false-: Conflicting directions from bystanders threaten to send the chase down the wrong street.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.social-closed: A guarded private courtyard offers the shortest route, but access is not freely given.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.social-panick: A frightened crowd surges unpredictably and blocks the pursuit with bodies and shouting.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.social-checkp: Officials stop everyone passing through and demand names, papers, or a convincing reason.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.social-helpfu: A witness saw the quarry pass and can reveal a valuable shortcut if convinced quickly.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.social-tavern: The chase bursts through a tavern just as an argument turns into a full-room brawl.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.social-vendor: A vendor and customers spill across the route, protecting fragile wares from the rushing chase.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.social-noble-: A formal procession occupies the entire avenue and expects everyone else to yield.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.social-rumor-: Word of the chase spreads faster than the runners, but useful information is mixed with noise.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.social-guard-: Alert guards stop the pursuers and insist on knowing exactly what is happening.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.social-public: A street performance draws a dense ring of spectators around the quickest route.
PF2E_CHASE_FORGE.CoreCards.social-masque: Masks, costumes, and look-alike revelers make it difficult to keep the right person in sight.
